props.name: children
props.description: The `AccordionItem`s, in order.

props.name: value
props.description: The values of the open items when you control it. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The values of the items open at the start when the accordion keeps its own state. Default none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the values of all open items after one opens or closes.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Let several items stay open at once. By default opening one closes the others.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading level of every item's title, so the sections fit the page's outline. Default 3.

props.name: value
props.description: The item's identity, used in `value` and `defaultValue`. Must be unique inside one Accordion.

props.name: title
props.description: The title printed on the header. Name the section with a noun.

props.name: children
props.description: The content that opens under the title. It is not mounted while the item is closed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The header cannot be pressed and leaves the tab order.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the sheet is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it; leave it out to let `trigger` open it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state on first render when the sheet is not controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` when the sheet asks to close (Cancel, Escape, a click outside or an action) and with `true` when `trigger` is pressed.

props.name: title
props.description: The object the actions are for, such as "Kitchen lamp". It is required, because it names the sheet.

props.name: detail
props.description: One quiet line under the name, such as "lamp 02 · Kitchen".

props.name: items
props.description: The actions, three to six, in the order they are printed. Put destructive actions last.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the action's value once the sheet has closed and focus is back on the opener.

props.name: trigger
props.type: ReactElement<{ onClick?: ((e: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent>) => void); }, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
props.description: An element, usually a `Menu`-like round key or a `Button`, that opens the sheet. The anchored panel stands by it and focus returns to it.

props.name: placement
props.description: `auto` (default) docks to the bottom edge on a screen taller than it is wide and stands by the trigger otherwise. `bottom` always docks; `anchored` always stands by the trigger.

props.name: modal
props.description: `true` (default) opens with `showModal()`. `false` shows the docked lid in place, for previews.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: The word on the Cancel key. Defaults to "Cancel".

props.name: items
props.description: The headings of the page, in the order they stand on it. Put sub-headings in an item's `items`.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the landmark that assistive tech lists. Pass your own for another language. Defaults to "On this page".

props.name: value
props.description: The id of the current section, when you set it yourself. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The id of the section marked at first, when the list follows the page by itself.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the id of the new current section, from scrolling or from a press.

props.name: offset
props.description: Height in CSS pixels of anything fixed to the top of the scrolling area, such as a header. A heading counts as reached once it is below it. Default 0.

props.name: root
props.description: The scrolling element that holds the headings: the element itself, or a CSS selector such as `#page`. Leave it out when the page itself scrolls.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the landmark.

props.name: children
props.description: The page itself. It is rendered inside the `main` landmark, which is where the skip link and `focusKey` send focus.

props.name: header
props.description: The top unit, usually a `Navbar` (which is the banner landmark itself). Pass a function to get `compact`, `menuOpen` and `openMenu`, so the Navbar's Menu key can open the Drawer.

props.name: sidebar
props.description: The side column, usually a `Sidebar`. At and above `breakpoint` it stands at the inline start; below it, it moves into a Drawer.

props.name: footer
props.description: The bottom unit. It is rendered in a `footer` landmark. Leave it out for none.

props.name: breakpoint
props.description: The width, as a breakpoint token, under which the side column folds into a Drawer. The shell measures its own width with a ResizeObserver, not the window's. Default `md` (768px).

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Hold the header at the top edge while the page scrolls. Default `false`.

props.name: focusKey
props.description: Any value that changes on navigation, such as the router's pathname. When it changes, focus moves to `main` and an open Drawer closes. It is ignored on first render.

props.name: menuOpen
props.description: Controlled: whether the Drawer is open. Pair it with `onMenuOpenChange`.

props.name: defaultMenuOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled: whether the Drawer starts open. Default `false`.

props.name: onMenuOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the Drawer opens or asks to close.

props.name: skipLabel
props.description: The text of the skip link, the first stop for the keyboard. Pass your own for another language. Defaults to "Skip to main content".

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: The Drawer's title and the name of the built-in Menu key. Pass your own for another language. Defaults to "Menu".

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the shell.

props.name: ratio
props.description: The proportion, width over height. One of 1/1, 4/3, 16/9 (the default) or 3/2.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Rounds the frame with the media corner, the same radius the windows use. Off by default.

props.name: onSubmit

props.name: defaultEmail
props.description: The email the field starts with. The fields keep their own state; read them in `onSubmit`.

props.name: remember
props.description: Show the remember-me option. Default false.

props.name: forgotHref

props.name: forgotLink

props.name: alternateHref

props.name: alternateLink

props.description: The text in the field when controlled. Pair it with `onValueChange`. It is the person's own text, not an option's value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting text when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new text each time the person types, and with the option's label when a suggestion is chosen.

props.name: onChoose
props.description: Called when a suggestion is chosen with the Enter key or a press, not when text is typed. Use it when the choice matters more than the words.

props.name: filter
props.description: How suggestions are narrowed as the person types. The default keeps options whose label contains the text, ignoring case. Pass your own function, or `false` when the source already filtered.

props.name: loading
props.description: The source is working. The panel shows a Spinner row; any suggestions already there stay. Turn it on while an async request runs.

props.name: emptyText
props.default: No suggestions. Your text stays as typed.
props.description: The line printed when nothing matches. The default says the typed text stays valid. Pass your own for another language.

props.name: busyText
props.description: The word printed beside the Spinner while `loading`. The default is "Searching".

props.name: listLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the suggestion list. The default is "Suggestions".

props.name: size

props.name: limit

props.name: label

props.name: hint
props.description: A short line printed under the well that says what to enter, for example the format.

props.name: error
props.description: The problem with the current value. When set, the field is marked invalid and the message is printed under the well with a glyph.

props.name: unit
props.description: A unit printed inside the well after the value, for example `°C` or `min`. It is read out with the field.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's or owner's name. The initials are taken from it when there is no picture.

props.name: src
props.description: The picture's address. If it fails to load, the window falls back to the initials.

props.name: initials
props.description: Letters to print instead of the ones taken from `name`. One or two letters read best.

props.description: Window size: `sm` 32px, `md` 44px, `lg` 80px. Default `md`.

props.name: label
props.description:

because the name is normally printed beside it. Pass a label when nothing else names the person.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the window.

props.name: children

props.name: tone
props.description: Which status lamp is printed. `neutral` (default) is a hollow ring, `positive` a dot, `warning` a triangle, `critical` a square, `info` a diamond.

props.name: count
props.description: A number printed before the word in tabular figures, for the count form such as "3 offline".

props.name: tone
props.description: `neutral` (default) a standing note, `positive` a good condition, `warning` something needs care soon, `critical` something does not work. No tone is orange.

props.name: status
props.description: The status word printed beside the glyph, such as "Offline". Defaults to Note, Done, Check or Failed by tone.

props.name: children
props.description: What holds and what happens next, such as "The hub is offline. Controls will work again when it reconnects."

props.name: action
props.description: One optional plastic key that helps end the condition.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows the round dismiss key and runs when it is pressed. Leave it out for a condition that must stay until it ends.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the dismiss key. Defaults to "Dismiss".

props.name: label
props.description: What the chart shows, such as "Energy by day". Printed above the window and used as its accessible name.

props.name: categories
props.description: The category names, one for each group of bars.

props.name: series
props.description: The series. Each series gets its own pattern and one bar in every category.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Whether the bars rise from the bottom or run from the start edge. Default "vertical".

props.name: max
props.description: The value the scale must reach. Rounded up to a round number. Default: the largest value.

props.name: height
props.description: Block size of the drawing in pixels. Default: the layout frame size for a vertical chart, and enough rows for a horizontal one.

props.name: showValues
props.description: Print each bar's value on it. Values that do not fit the bar's width are left to the readout. Default true.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Turns a value into the text said in the readout and listed in the table, for example `(v) => v + ' kWh'`.

props.name: formatMark
props.description: Turns a value into the short text printed on its bar. Defaults to the plain number, so the unit goes in the title and the bars stay narrow.

props.name: formatTick
props.description: Turns a scale value into the text printed on the value axis. Defaults to the plain number.

props.name: words
props.description: The words the chart speaks. Each one has an English default.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Called with the category and series index when a bar becomes active, from the keys or a pointer.

props.name: items
props.description: The sections in order, three to five of them.

props.name: current
props.description: The value of the section on screen now. Its link carries aria-current="page", medium weight and the ink mark.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called when a link is pressed, with its value and the click. Call `event.preventDefault()` to route in the app instead of loading the page.

props.name: layout
props.description: `auto` (default) prints a strip along the bottom on a screen taller than it is wide and a rail at the inline start otherwise. `bar` and `rail` hold one form.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Fixes the nav to the screen edge with its safe area, for the app shell. Leave it off to place it yourself.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the navigation landmark. Defaults to "Main".

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render. Defaults to `div`. Pick the one that matches the content, such as `section` or `li`.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inset on all sides. none is 0, xs 4px, sm 8, md 16, lg 24 and xl 32. Defaults to none.

props.name: surface
props.description: Ground colour. Leave it out for no fill at all; the three values are the page, raised and sunken grounds.

props.name: corner
props.description: Corner radius. Leave it out for square corners. mark is the smallest, panel the body radius.

props.name: children
props.description: The words of this level, a noun such as "Lamps".

props.name: href
props.description: Where the level goes. Not needed on the last level, which is the page you are on.

props.name: current
props.description: Marks the page you are on. `Breadcrumb` sets it on the last level for you; it prints plain text with an ink index mark and is announced with aria-current="page".

props.name: asChild
props.description: Hand the link styles to your own child, such as a router link, instead of printing an anchor.

props.name: children
props.description: The levels of the path from the top down, as `Crumb`s. The last one is the page you are on.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the landmark that assistive tech lists. Pass your own for another language. Defaults to "Breadcrumb".

props.name: fold
props.description: `auto` (default) folds the middle levels into one key when the path does not fit its width; `always` folds whenever there are three or more levels; `never` lets the row wrap instead.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: The name of the folded key. Pass your own for another language. Defaults to "Show full path".

props.name: kind

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default) is 44px tall; `lg` is 52px, for the main action of a sheet on a phone.

props.name: full
props.description: Stretch to the full width of the container.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The day to start on when you do not control it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the day, "yyyy-mm-dd", when one is chosen by a press, Enter or Space.

props.name: month
props.description: The month on show as "yyyy-mm". Pass it with `onMonthChange` to control the month yourself.

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description: The month to open on when you do not control it. Defaults to the chosen day's month, else this month.

props.name: onMonthChange
props.description: Called with "yyyy-mm" when the month on show changes, by a month key, the Page keys or an arrow that crosses the edge.

props.name: min

props.name: max
props.description: The latest day that can be chosen, "yyyy-mm-dd". Later days are shown as unavailable.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Return true for a day that cannot be chosen, such as a weekend or a day already booked.

props.name: weekStart

props.name: locale

props.name: disabled

props.name: readOnly

props.name: dayLabel
props.description: The name read out for a day, such as "Wednesday, 4 November 2026". Pass your own for another wording. Defaults to a full Intl date.

props.name: previousLabel

props.name: onDayHover

props.name: rangeLabels

props.description: Class name for the Calendar.

props.name: footer

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The colour chosen at the start when the picker keeps its own state.

props.name: onValueChange

props.name: hue
props.description: Show a hue fader under the readout. Moving it sets a custom colour at fixed saturation and lightness. Default false.

props.name: hex
props.description: Show a hex well under the readout. A valid entry sets the colour as you type; an invalid one prints a message and is dropped on leaving the field. Default false.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name. When set, a hidden input carries the chosen colour so a form submits it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The keys, the fader and the well cannot be used; the keys lose their height.

props.name: hueLabel
props.description: The words printed on the hue fader. Pass your own for another language.

props.name: hexLabel
props.description: The words printed on the hex well. Pass your own for another language.

props.name: hexError
props.default: Enter three or six hex digits.
props.description: The message printed under the hex well for an entry that is not a colour.

props.default:

  swatch ? messages.colorPicker.chosen(swatch.name) : hex ? messages.colorPicker.custom(hex) : messages.colorPicker.none

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the root.

props.name: label
props.description: The printed name above the well. It is required, because it is also the field's accessible name, which `placeholder` cannot be.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices, in the order they are listed. Typing narrows them; a person can only end up with one of these.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen value when controlled. Pair it with `onValueChange`. `null` means nothing is chosen.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the option's value when a different option is chosen, and with `null` when the person clears the text and leaves the field.

props.name: onInputChange
props.description: Called with the text in the well each time it changes by typing. Use it to load options from a server.

props.name: filter
props.description: Decides whether an option stays in the list for the typed text. The default keeps options whose label contains the text, ignoring case.

props.name: hint
props.description: A short line printed under the well that says what to enter.

props.name: error
props.description: The problem with the current value. When set, the field is marked invalid and the message is printed under the well with a glyph.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default) is a 44px well and 44px rows; `lg` is a 52px well with larger text, for the main field of a phone sheet.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: The line printed in the list when no option matches. The default is "No match".

props.name: toggleLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the key at the end of the well that opens the list. The default is "Show options".

props.name: disabled
props.description: The field cannot be used; the well loses its shadow and fades to half.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the chosen value with a form under this name, through a hidden input. The typed text is never submitted.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the outer wrapper (label, well and messages).

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the outer wrapper.

props.name: commands
props.description: The commands to list. Pass all of them; the palette filters as the person types.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the palette is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it; leave it out to let `hotkey` and `trigger` open it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state on first render when the palette is not controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` on Escape, a click on the scrim or a run that closes the palette, and with `true` when `hotkey` or `trigger` opens it.

props.name: onRun
props.description: Called with the command that ran, after its own `onRun`.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: The chord that opens and closes the palette from anywhere on the page, such as `mod+k` (default; `mod` is Cmd on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere) or `ctrl+shift+p`. Pass `false` for none.

props.name: query
props.description: The text in the field when controlled. Pair it with `onQueryChange`.

props.name: defaultQuery
props.description: The starting text when uncontrolled. The text is cleared each time the palette closes.

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Called with the new text each time the person types.

props.name: filter
props.description: Decides whether a command shows for the current text. The default matches every word of the text against the label, the section and the keywords, ignoring case.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the palette, read when it opens and used as the field's name. Defaults to "Command palette".

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The hint inside the empty field. Defaults to "Type a command".

props.name: listLabel
props.description: The name of the list of commands. Defaults to "Commands".

props.name: emptyText
props.description: The line printed and announced when no command matches. Defaults to "No matching command".

props.name: resultsText
props.default: (n: number) => (n === 0 ? 'No matching command' : n === 1 ? '1 command' : `${n} commands`)

props.name: closeOnRun
props.description: Close the palette after a command runs. Default `true`.

props.name: trigger
props.type: ReactElement<{ onClick?: ((e: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent>) => void); }, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
props.description: An element, usually a `Button`, that opens the palette when pressed. Focus returns to it on close.

props.name: modal
props.description: `true` (default) opens with `showModal()`, with a scrim, a focus trap and an inert page. `false` shows the palette in place, with no scrim and no focus move, for previews.

props.name: size
props.description: Maximum width. sm is 640px, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1200 (the default) and 2xl 1440.

props.name: items
props.description: The actions, in the order they are printed, in the same shape as Menu's. Put destructive actions last. Every one of them must also be reachable some other way, such as a visible Menu key.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the action's value when it runs, after the panel has closed and focus has gone back.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the panel, such as "Actions for Kitchen lamp". It defaults to the built-in word "Actions".

props.name: disabled
props.description: The menu does not open and the browser's own menu is left alone.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the panel opens or closes.

props.name: pressDelay
props.description: How long a finger or pen must stay down before the panel opens, in milliseconds. Defaults to 500.

props.name: columns
props.description: The columns, in order. Each has a `key`, a `header` and an `accessor` or `render`.

props.name: rows
props.description: The rows to print.

props.name: getRowKey

props.name: caption
props.description: A visible title printed above the header. It names the grid for assistive tech.

props.name: label

props.name: visibleRows

props.name: selectionMode

props.name: selected
props.description: The keys of the marked rows when you control them. Pair it with `onSelectedChange`.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The keys of the rows marked at the start, when the grid keeps its own state.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the keys of all marked rows when a row is marked or cleared.

props.name: sort
props.description: The sorted column when you control it. `null` means rows keep your order. Pair it with `onSortChange`.

props.name: defaultSort
props.description: The sorted column at the start, when the grid keeps its own state.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called with the new sort when a header is pressed; `null` when the third press clears it.

props.name: manualSort
props.description: Leaves ordering to you. The grid still shows the chevron and calls `onSortChange`, but prints `rows` as given. Default false.

props.name: empty

props.name: selectAllLabel

props.name: selectRowLabel

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the table element.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the table element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the grid's table element.

props.name: label
props.description: The printed name above the window. It is required, because it is also the field's accessible name.

props.name: value

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The day to start on when you do not control it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the day, "yyyy-mm-dd", or null when the field is cleared. It fires when a typed date is committed (Enter or leaving the field) and when a day is chosen on the Calendar.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest day that can be chosen, "yyyy-mm-dd". A typed date before it is refused.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest day that can be chosen, "yyyy-mm-dd". A typed date after it is refused.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Return true for a day that cannot be chosen, such as a weekend or a day already booked.

props.name: weekStart
props.description: The first column of the Calendar week: 0 is Sunday, 1 is Monday, up to 6. Default 1.

props.name: locale
props.description: A BCP 47 tag such as "th" or "de". It sets the order a typed date is read in and the words on the Calendar. Default "en".

props.name: today
props.description: The day to treat as today on the Calendar, "yyyy-mm-dd". Defaults to the visitor's own date.

props.name: hint
props.description: A short line under the row. It defaults to the accepted formats. Pass `false` to print none.

props.name: error

props.name: chooseLabel
props.description: The name of the calendar key and of its panel. Pass your own for another language. Defaults to "Choose date".

props.name: formatWords
props.type: { day: string; month: string; year: string; }

props.name: invalidMessage
props.description: The message for text that is not a real date. It receives the format in the locale's order and in ISO.

props.name: unavailableMessage

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The text can be read and copied but not changed, and the calendar key is off.

props.name: name
props.description: When set, a hidden field with this name carries the chosen day as "yyyy-mm-dd" in a form.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the outer wrapper (label, row and message).

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the outer wrapper.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `stacked` (default) prints each term over its values and fits a narrow unit. `inline` puts the terms in one column with the values beside them.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Marks a figure. In the inline layout a numeric value lines up on the end edge, so values of different length share their last digit. Default off.

props.name: model
props.description: The model name printed bottom-right, such as "tuner 1". Printed in lowercase.

props.name: wordmark
props.description: The wordmark printed bottom-left. Defaults to "dial".

props.name: display
props.description: The window that says what the device is doing now. Always the first part of the unit.

props.name: knob
props.description: The orange knob, the unit's one loud part. It is sized to corner.knob-ratio (0.36) of the body's short side.

props.name: primary
props.description: The main key when there is no knob. It is orange only then; next to a knob it is drawn as a plastic key, so the unit never has two orange parts.

props.name: keys
props.description: Secondary keys in the body colour, for modes, bands and transport.

props.name: keysLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the row of keys, such as "Band" or "Playback".

props.name: meter
props.description: A grille meter for a reading that changes, such as volume or heat output. Leave it out when nothing is measured.

props.name: fader
props.description: A ruler fader across the body for a second amount, such as volume or brightness.

props.name: layout
props.description: `a` (default) is anchor A, with the display on top, the knob left, keys and grille right and the fader across. `tall` is one column with the knob centred, for wall devices. `compact` is a wide body with the knob right of the display.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the sheet is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the dialog; leave it out to let `trigger` open it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state on first render when the dialog is not controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` when the sheet asks to close, on Escape or on any key in `actions`. Called with `true` when `trigger` is pressed.

props.name: title
props.description: The one question the sheet asks, such as "Turn off all lamps?". It is required, because it names the dialog.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences under the question that say what will happen. It describes the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: Fields or extra content between the description and the keys. The first field takes focus on open.

props.name: actions
props.description: The keys at the bottom, plastic `Button`s and at most one `Button kind="primary"`, the main one last. Any key here closes the sheet after its own onClick, unless that onClick calls `event.preventDefault()`.

props.name: trigger
props.type: ReactElement<{ onClick?: ((e: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent>) => void); }, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
props.description: An element, usually a `Button`, that opens the sheet when pressed. Focus returns to it on close.

props.name: modal
props.description: `true` (default) opens with `showModal()`, with a scrim, a focus trap and an inert page. `false` shows the sheet in place, with no scrim and no focus move, for previews.

props.name: kind
props.description: `lcd` (default) draws the value as dark 7-segment digits on grey-green; `oled` sets it in white grotesk on near-black.

props.name: value
props.description: The reading, as text. On `lcd` the digits 0 to 9, a minus, a space, a decimal point and a few letters (A b C d E F H L n o P r t U) are drawn as segments.

props.name: unit
props.description: The unit printed beside the value, such as °C, min or MHz.

props.name: detail
props.description: One short line of detail with the value, such as "Heating to 22.0" or "Rinse".

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the window, such as "Thermostat". The window is announced politely when its reading changes.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` 24px digits, `md` (default) 40px digits, `lg` 56px digits; on `oled` the value line steps with it.

props.name: digits
props.description: The number of digit cells, on `lcd` only. Shorter values are padded on the left with unlit cells, so the window never changes width.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `horizontal` parts what is above from what is below; `vertical` parts side-by-side regions. Default `horizontal`.

props.name: label
props.description: A short lowercase word printed on the seam, a little in from its start. Horizontal only; ignored when vertical.

props.name: decorative
props.description: True when the seam is only a visual gap and carries no meaning. It is then hidden from assistive tech (role="none"). Default false.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the seam.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the seam.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the drawer is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the drawer; leave it out to let `trigger` open it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state on first render when the drawer is not controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` when the drawer asks to close (the close key, Escape or a scrim click) and with `true` when `trigger` is pressed.

props.name: title
props.description: What the drawer lists, such as "Rooms". It is required, because it names the drawer.

props.name: children
props.description: The list or filters to pick from. It takes the height between the header and the keys and scrolls inside itself.

props.name: actions
props.description: Optional keys at the bottom, such as "Add room". At most one `Button kind="primary"`.

props.name: trigger
props.type: ReactElement<{ onClick?: ((e: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent>) => void); }, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
props.description: An element, usually a `Button`, that opens the drawer when pressed. Focus returns to it on close.

props.name: side
props.description: `end` (default) slides in from the inline end, the right in left-to-right text. `start` slides in from the inline start.

props.name: modal
props.description: `true` (default) opens with `showModal()`, with a scrim, a focus trap and an inert page. `false` shows the drawer in place, for previews.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the round close key in the header. Defaults to "Close".

props.name: onFilesReject

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the tray off: no drop, and the key is disabled.

props.name: name

props.name: title

props.name: overTitle

props.name: hint

props.name: overHint

props.name: chooseLabel

props.name: rejectedLabel

props.name: style

props.name: value

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting value when uncontrolled. Leave it out for an empty value.

props.name: onValueChange

props.name: onEditingChange

props.name: placeholder

props.name: hint

props.name: error

props.name: readOnly

props.name: style

props.name: title

props.name: children

props.name: action
props.description: The one key, usually a `Button`. Use `kind="primary"` only when filling this place is the screen's main action.

props.name: drawing

props.name: room

props.name: temperature

props.name: detail

props.name: displayKind

props.name: readings

props.name: activity

props.name: readAt

props.name: status

props.name: statusText
props.description: The words of the notice line, to replace the defaults "Up to date", "No new reading since 10:17" and "Not answering since 09:58".

props.name: name
props.description: The part's name, as the manual prints it under the knob, such as "Volume".

props.name: does
props.description: One line of what the part does, such as "Sets how loud the speaker plays". Never its current value.

props.name: children
props.description: The part itself, one control or one window.

props.name: children
props.description: The unit or screen whose parts are explained. Mark each part with `Explain` or a `data-explain="Name|What it does"` attribute.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the printing is up, when the owner holds the state.

props.name: defaultOpen

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Runs with the new state when the key, the shortcut or Escape turns the mode on or off.

props.name: toggle

props.name: toggleLabel

props.name: shortcut
props.description: The key that turns the mode on and off while focus is inside, outside a text field. Defaults to "?".

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the seat the key sits in, the part that is positioned.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the seat the key sits in.

props.name: children
props.description: The posts, as `FeedItem` elements written directly as children (not wrapped in a fragment or another component), so each can be given its position.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the feed for assistive tech, such as "Activity". Required unless `aria-labelledby` names it.

props.name: busy
props.description: True while more posts are being fetched. The feed is marked `aria-busy`, the load more key is replaced by a loading mark, and `onNearEnd` does not fire. Default false.

props.name: hasMore

props.name: children
props.description: The pages of the group, as `SidebarItem`s.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the group.

props.name: children
props.description: The page's name, a noun such as "Kitchen". Collapsed, it is kept for assistive tech and shown as a tooltip but not drawn. With `asChild`, pass one element such as a router link.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the page goes.

props.name: icon
props.description: A glyph from dial's dot-matrix set, printed at the start of the row. Needed for the column to be useful when collapsed.

props.name: current
props.description: The page you are on. Sets aria-current="page", turns the name to medium weight and prints the index mark. Mark one item per page.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Hand the link styles to your own child, such as a router link, instead of printing an anchor.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the link.

props.name: collapseLabel
props.description: The word printed beside the chevron while the column is open. Pass your own for another language. Defaults to "Collapse".

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: The key's name while the column is collapsed, for assistive tech. Pass your own for another language. Defaults to "Expand".

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the key.

props.name: kind
props.description: What is still loading. `text` (default) is lines of text, `display` a Display reading, `grille` a Grille meter, `disc` a key or knob, `block` a chart or picture area.

props.name: size
props.description: Matches the size of the part that will replace it. For `text` it is caption, body (default) or title type. For `display` it is 24, 40 or 56px digits. For `disc` it is a 44, 72 or 108px part.

props.name: lines
props.description: The number of text lines, on `text` only. Default 1.

props.name: lastLine
props.description: The width of the last text line as a share of the others, from 0 to 1. Default 1 for one line and 0.6 for more.

props.name: extent
props.description: The inline size of a `text` placeholder, or the diameter of a `disc` or the block size of a `block`, in px or any CSS length.

props.name: digits
props.description: The number of digit cells, on `display` only. Use the `digits` of the Display it stands for. Default 4.

props.name: unit
props.description: The unit the Display will print, on `display` only. It is kept hidden, so the window reserves its width.

props.name: detail
props.description: Reserves the Display's detail line, on `display` only.

props.name: cols
props.description: The grille's columns, on `grille` only. Use the `cols` of the Grille it stands for. Default 6.

props.name: rows
props.description: The grille's rows, on `grille` only. Default 3.

props.name: label
props.description: The printed name above the fader. It is required, because it is also the slider's accessible name.

props.name: min
props.description: The lowest value, at the start of the groove. Default 0.

props.name: max
props.description: The highest value, at the end of the groove. Default 10.

props.name: step
props.description: The distance between detents. When set, the cap settles into the nearest detent and the ruler prints one tick per detent (up to 20). Leave it out for a fader with no detents.

props.name: value
props.description: The value when controlled. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting value when uncontrolled. Default `min`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value whenever a key, a drag or a click moves the cap to another value.

props.name: scale
props.description: Print the ruler's numerals under the groove ("audio 1" scale). Default false.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Turns a value into the printed and announced text, for example `(v) => v + ' %'`.

props.name: pageStep
props.description: The distance PageUp and PageDown move. It defaults to a tenth of the range, and at least two detents.

props.name: tint
props.description: The range the value belongs to, which tints the glass cap and the light in the groove behind it. Use warm for heat, cool for cooling and neutral for anything else. Default neutral.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The fader cannot be moved; the cap loses its height.

props.name: mass
props.description: Spring mass of the cap. Default 1.4 (mechanism.mass).

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness. Default 520 (mechanism.stiffness).

props.name: damping
props.description: Spring damping. Default 46 (mechanism.damping).

props.name: label
props.description: The room or device the slot belongs to, such as "Living room". Printed under the slit and used in every announcement.

props.name: scene
props.description: The scene in the slot when controlled, or null when it is empty. Pair it with `onSceneChange`.

props.name: defaultScene
props.description: The scene in the slot at the start when uncontrolled. It does not run again on load.

props.name: onSceneChange
props.description: Called with the new scene after a card goes in, or null after it is taken out.

props.name: onInsert
props.description: Called when a card is inserted, to run its scene.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called when the inserted card is taken out.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The slot takes no card, for a unit that is offline.

props.name: words
props.description: Your own words for the legend, the lamp and the announcements.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default time on screen in ms. Never less than 5000.

props.name: aboveNav
props.description: `true` (default) lifts the snackbar above a BottomNav strip on a tall screen. Set `false` for an app with no bottom nav.

props.name: tone
props.description: `positive` (default) the action worked, `neutral` a plain note, `warning` it worked with a catch, `critical` it failed. No tone is orange.

props.name: status
props.description: The status word printed beside the glyph. Defaults to Done, Note, Check or Failed by tone.

props.name: children
props.description: The message, short and in the past tense, such as "Lamp removed".

props.name: action
props.description: At most one plastic key, the action that undoes, such as Undo.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Runs after the action key is pressed, so the owner can close the snackbar.

props.name: size
props.description: Room to leave. xs is 4px, sm 8, md 16 (the default), lg 24 and xl 32, the same steps as Stack gaps.

props.name: axis
props.description: `block` (default) leaves room in the column; `inline` leaves room in a row.

props.name: flexible
props.description: Take all the room that is left, with `size` as the least it keeps. Use it in a row or column to push siblings apart.

props.name: label
props.description: What the trend shows, such as "Energy, last 7 days". It is the start of the accessible name, so name the reading and the period.

props.name: values
props.description: The readings, oldest first. Evenly spaced; an empty list prints a flat rule and says "No readings".

props.name: unit
props.description: The unit read after a value in the summary and printed after the last value, such as kWh.

props.name: format
props.description: Your own way to write a value, for another language or number format. Receives the raw number.

props.name: min
props.description: The lowest value of the scale. Pass the same `min` and `max` to a column of Sparklines to draw them on one scale. Default: the lowest reading.

props.name: max
props.description: The highest value of the scale. Default: the highest reading.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Print the last value after the line, in tabular numerals. The label already carries it for assistive tech. Default false.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` is word height, `md` (default) suits a table cell or list row, `lg` is wide enough to read shape beside a Stat.

props.name: summary
props.description: Your own sentence read after the label. Defaults to one built from the readings.

props.name: words
props.description: Your own words for another language. Defaults are English.

props.name: label
props.description: What is busy, in words for assistive tech, such as "Saving" or "Asking the hub". Defaults to "Loading". Pass your own for another language.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Prints the label beside the holes. Off by default, when the label is read out but not drawn. Turn it on when reduced motion matters or the wait is long.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` (default) uses 8px holes like a Grille in a list row; `md` uses 12px holes for a Spinner that stands alone.

props.name: direction
props.description: `column` (default) stacks vertically; `row` lays out inline and wraps.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children. xs is 4px, sm 8, md 16 (the default), lg 24 and xl 32.

props.name: align
props.description: Cross-axis alignment.

props.name: label
props.description: What the figure is, such as "Energy today". Printed above the window and used as the accessible name.

props.name: value
props.description: The figure. Leave it out, or pass null or an empty string, when there is no reading: the window then prints a dash and says "No reading".

props.name: unit
props.description: The unit printed beside the figure, such as kWh, °C or %.

props.name: change
props.description: The size of the change, as text, such as "0.8 kWh" or "4%". Leave it out for a Stat with no change line.

props.name: trend
props.description: The direction of the change, told by a glyph and a word and never by colour. Default `flat`.

props.name: compare
props.description: What the change is measured against, such as "since yesterday". Printed after the amount.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` sets the figure at emphasis size, `md` (default) at title size, `lg` at display size.

props.name: live
props.description: Makes the Stat a polite live region that reads the whole reading when it changes. Default off: a plain labelled group.

props.name: words
props.description: Your own words for the three directions and for an empty reading, for another language. Defaults to Up, Down, No change and No reading.

props.name: children
props.description: The steps, in order. The numbers are counted by position.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the list.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the list.

props.name: title
props.description: The step's printed name, level with its number window.

props.name: status
props.description: `current` is announced with aria-current="step"; `done` prints a check in the window. Default `upcoming`.

props.name: children
props.description: The section's content, stood under the title.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: The word read out for a done step's check. Pass your own for another language.

props.name: label
props.description: What the switch turns on or off, printed beside it. It names the switch for assistive tech. Without it, pass `aria-label`.

props.name: onLabel
props.description: Word printed at the on end of the groove, such as "On" or "Cook". Printing only; the state is announced by the role.

props.name: offLabel
props.description: Word printed at the off end of the groove, such as "Off" or "Warm". Printing only; the state is announced by the role.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the switch is on (controlled). Pair it with `onCheckedChange`.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Whether the switch starts on when it is uncontrolled. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new position each time the switch is thrown by pointer, Space or Enter.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Flattens the cap and stops the switch from being thrown.

props.name: children
props.description: The header, body and rows of the table.

props.name: caption
props.description: A visible title printed above the header. It also names the scroll region when the columns overflow.

props.name: label
props.description: The name read out for the scroll region when there is no `caption`. Default "Table"; pass your own for another language.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the table element.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the table element.

props.name: children
props.description: Rows of this section.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the section.

props.name: children
props.description: Rows of this section.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the section.

props.name: children
props.description: The cells of this row.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the row.

props.name: children
props.description: The reading in this cell.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Aligns the cell to the end edge in tabular figures. Use it on every cell of a column of numbers. Default false.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the cell.

props.name: children
props.description: The column or row label.

props.name: scope
props.description: Which cells this header names. Default `col`; use `row` for a header at the start of a row.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Aligns the header to the end edge. Set it on the header of a numeric column. Default false.

props.name: sort
props.description: How the column is sorted now. It is announced with aria-sort and shown as a chevron. A header with `onSort` and no value counts as `none`.

props.name: onSort
props.description: Makes the header sortable: its label becomes a key that calls this on press, Enter or Space. Update `sort` yourself and reorder your rows.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the header cell.

props.name: label
props.description: What the sections are, such as Rooms. It is required, because it is the accessible name of the row of names.

props.name: items
props.description: The sections in order. Each has a value, a printed name and its content.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the chosen section, when you control it. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The section chosen at first, when the tabs keep their own state. It defaults to the first item.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value when another section is chosen.

props.name: activation
props.description: With `automatic` (default) the arrow keys choose the section they reach, because every panel is already on the page. With `manual` the arrows only move focus and Enter or Space chooses, for panels that are slow to show.

props.name: label
props.description: The printed name above the well. It is required, because it also names the text field and the list of tags.

props.name: hint
props.description: A short line printed under the well that says which keys add and remove a tag.

props.name: error
props.description: A problem with the current tags that you found yourself, for example "Add at least one room". It is printed under the well with a glyph and wins over the field's own refusal message.

props.name: value
props.description: The tags (controlled). Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The tags the field starts with when it is uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new list each time a tag is added or removed.

props.name: max
props.description: The most tags the field takes. At the limit a new tag is refused with `maxMessage`. Unset means no limit.

props.name: allowDuplicates
props.description: Lets the same tag be added twice. Off by default, and the comparison ignores case.

props.name: addOnBlur
props.description: Adds the text still in the field as a tag when the field loses focus. Defaults to `true`, so a typed word is not lost.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called with the text and the reason each time a tag is refused.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for a form. One hidden input with this name is printed per tag, so a form posts the list.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: The accessible name of each remove key. Defaults to "Remove" and the tag. Pass your own for another language.

props.name: duplicateMessage
props.description: The line printed and announced when a tag is already in the list. Defaults to "{tag} is already added".

props.name: maxMessage
props.description: The line printed and announced when `max` is reached. Defaults to "At most {max} tags".

props.name: addedMessage
props.description: The line announced when a tag is added. Defaults to "{tag} added".

props.name: removedMessage
props.description: The line announced when a tag is removed. Defaults to "{tag} removed".

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the outer wrapper (label, well and message).

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the outer wrapper.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render. Use `p` (default) for a paragraph, `span` inline, `div` for a block, `label` to name a field (pass `htmlFor`).

props.name: size
props.description: `micro` (11px, model names and scale numerals), `caption` (13px), `label` (14px), `body` (15px, the default) or `reading` (16px, prose capped at the measure).

props.name: tone
props.description: `primary` (default) is the darkest ink on plastic; `secondary` is one step lighter for notes and units. Both hold 4.5:1.

props.name: weight
props.description: `regular` (default) or `medium`. There is no bold and no italic.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Tabular figures, so a number that changes keeps its width.

props.name: label
props.description: The printed name above the well. It is required, because it is also the field's accessible name, which `placeholder` cannot be.

props.name: hint
props.description: A short line printed under the well that says what to write.

props.name: error
props.description: The problem with the current value. When set, the field is marked invalid and the message is printed under the well with a glyph.

props.name: countLabel
props.description: Words after the count, for example `characters`. Pass your own for another language. Printed only when `maxLength` is set.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the outer wrapper.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the outer wrapper.

props.name: label
props.description: The printed name above the well. It is required, because it also names the group of fields.

props.name: kind
props.description: `segment` (default) draws hour and minute as 7-segment figures, like a clock radio. `text` sets them in the grotesk, for dense forms.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: `24` (default) runs the hour through 00 to 23. With `12` the hour stops at 12 and AM and PM are printed in the well.

props.name: value
props.description: The time when controlled, as `HH:MM` on the 24 hour clock, or an empty string when it is not set. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting time when uncontrolled, as `HH:MM` on the 24 hour clock. Leave it out to start with no time set.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new time as `HH:MM` whenever a field steps, or with an empty string while hour or minute is not set.

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: How far the arrow keys and set keys move the minute. Default 1.

props.name: keys
props.description: Shows the round set keys under hour and minute. Default true for `segment` and false for `text`.

props.name: hint
props.description: A short line printed under the well, for example the time zone or what the time starts.

props.name: error
props.description: The problem with the current time. When set, the fields are marked invalid and the message is printed with a glyph.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The fields cannot be changed and the set keys are not shown.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The time can be read and focused but not changed, and the set keys are not shown.

props.name: required
props.description: The time must be set before the form is sent.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of a hidden form field that carries the time as `HH:MM`.

props.name: hourLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the hour field. Default "Hour".

props.name: minuteLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the minute field. Default "Minute".

props.name: periodLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the AM and PM field. Default "AM or PM".

props.name: periodWords
props.description: The printed words for the two halves of the day. Default `['AM', 'PM']`.

props.name: keyLabels
props.default: ['Earlier hour', 'Later hour', 'Earlier minute', 'Later minute'] as [string, string, string, string]
props.description: The names of the four set keys, in the order hour down, hour up, minute down, minute up.

props.name: children
props.description: The events, as `TimelineItem`s, in the order you want them read. Put the newest first.

props.name: time
props.description: The time the event happened, printed in the left column, such as `22:40` or `Mon 18:30`.

props.name: dateTime
props.description: A machine-readable date or time for the time element, such as `2026-11-04T22:40`. Optional.

props.name: title
props.description: The event's name, level with its node.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional text under the title.

props.name: latest
props.description: Lights this event: a filled node, a medium title and the word Latest. Use it on the newest event only.

props.name: latestLabel
props.description: The word read out for the lit node. Pass your own for another language. Defaults to "Latest".

props.name: duration
props.description: Default time on screen in ms for toasts without an action. Never less than 5000.

props.name: max
props.description: How many toasts show at once; older ones close first.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the region. Defaults to "Notifications".

props.name: tone
props.description: `neutral` (default) a plain note, `positive` the action worked, `warning` it worked with a catch, `critical` it failed. No tone is orange.

props.name: status
props.description: The status word printed beside the glyph. Defaults to Note, Done, Check or Failed by tone.

props.name: children
props.description: The message, short and in the past tense, such as "Lamp turned off".

props.name: action
props.description: One optional plastic key, such as Undo or Try again.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows the round close key and runs when it is pressed.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the close key. Defaults to "Close".

props.name: content
props.description: The printed name of the part: a few words, no sentence. A string that equals the part's own aria-label is not announced twice.

props.name: children
props.description: The part being named, one element that can take a ref and focus (a key, a link, a field). A disabled button gets no events, so wrap it in a span.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the part the tag stands on. It flips to the other side when there is no room. Default `top`.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds the pointer rests on the part before the tag shows. Keyboard focus shows it at once. Default 400.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The tag never shows.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the tag.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the tag.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the whole control for assistive tech, such as "Rooms on the night schedule". It is read as the group's name and is not printed.

props.name: options
props.description: Every row there is. A row stands in the chosen list when its value is in `value`, and in the available list otherwise.

props.name: value
props.description: The values in the chosen list when controlled, in any order; the list shows them in the order of `options`. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The values in the chosen list at the start when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with all chosen values, in the order of `options`, after rows are moved.

props.name: moveAll
props.description: Adds the keys that move every row at once (the "all" keys). Rows that are disabled stay where they are. Default `false`.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default) has 44px rows; `lg` has 52px rows with larger text, for a phone sheet.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Both lists and all keys take no input, and the windows fade to half.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the chosen values with a form under this name, through hidden inputs.

props.name: availableLabel
props.description: The printed name of the available list. The default is "Available".

props.name: chosenLabel
props.description: The printed name of the chosen list. The default is "Chosen".

props.name: addLabel
props.description: The name of the key that moves the marked rows into the chosen list. Pass your own for another language.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: The name of the key that moves the marked rows back.

props.name: addAllLabel
props.description: The name of the key that moves every available row into the chosen list. Only shown with `moveAll`.

props.name: removeAllLabel
props.description: The name of the key that moves every chosen row back. Only shown with `moveAll`.

props.name: emptyAvailableText
props.description: The line printed in the available list when it has no rows.

props.name: emptyChosenText
props.description: The line printed in the chosen list when it has no rows.

props.name: countText
props.default: (n: number, marked: number) => `${n === 1 ? '1 row' : `${n} rows`}, ${marked} marked`
props.description: Builds the count printed under a window, from the rows it holds and how many are marked.

props.name: movedText
props.type: ((moved: number, to: string, available: number, chosen: number) => string)
props.default:
(n: number, to: string, available: number, chosen: number) =>
      `${n === 1 ? '1 row' : `${n} rows`} moved to ${to}. ${available} available, ${chosen} chosen.`
props.description: Builds the polite status read out after a move, from the rows moved, the name of the list they went to and the new totals.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the group of keys, such as "Playback" or "Modes". It is required, because a group with no name is just noise to a screen reader.

props.name: children
props.description: The small keys and lamps, such as IconButtons, Buttons and Badges. Each keeps its own size; the tray wraps to another row instead of shrinking them.

props.name: children
props.description: The top-level `TreeItem`s, in order. Name the tree with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the chosen item when you control it, or `null` for none. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the item chosen at the start when the tree keeps its own state. Default none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the value of an item when it is chosen by click, Enter or Space.

props.name: expanded
props.description: The values of the open branches when you control it. Pair it with `onExpandedChange`.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: The values of the branches open at the start when the tree keeps its own state. Default none.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the values of all open branches after one opens or closes.

props.name: value
props.description: The item's identity, used in `value`, `expanded` and the key map. Must be unique inside one TreeView.

props.name: label
props.description: The item's printed name. Type-ahead matches the start of this text.

props.name: leading
props.description: An optional node before the name, such as a dot-matrix `<Icon>`. It is decoration and is hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The item cannot be chosen or opened, and the arrow keys skip it.

props.name: children
props.description: Nested `TreeItem`s. An item that has any is a branch and can open; it is not mounted while closed.

props.name: count
props.description: How many rows there are in all. Only the ones in view (and a few beyond) are put in the page.

props.name: getItem
props.description: Gives the row at `index`. Call it for any index from 0 to `count - 1`; keep it cheap and keep the result the same for the same index.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the list for assistive tech, such as "All devices" or "Library". Required unless a heading names the list with `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: visibleRows
props.description: How many rows tall the window is. The body takes this height, or less when there are fewer rows. Default 6.

props.name: overscan
props.description: How many rows beyond the window are kept in the page on each side, so fast scrolling does not show blanks. Default 4.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen row's index when controlled. Pair it with `onValueChange`. `null` means no row is chosen.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The chosen row's index at the start, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange

props.name: children
props.description: The words (or one focusable element such as a skip link) to hide from sight and keep for assistive tech.

props.name: focusable
props.description: Show the content as a raised key at the start corner while it holds keyboard focus. Use it for a skip link. The content must contain something focusable, or with `asChild` be focusable itself. Default false.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Hand the hiding styles to your own child, such as an anchor or a router link, instead of printing a span.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the wrapper.

props.name: id
props.description: The id links use in `from` and `to`. Unique inside one Wiring.

props.name: children
props.description: The part, such as a Rotary, a DeviceCard or a TimePicker.

props.name: label
props.description: The group's lowercase name printed over its box, such as "heating".

props.name: children
props.description: The related nodes inside the box.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the list of relations for assistive technology, such as "Heating relations".

props.name: links
props.description: The relations to print. Each joins two `Wiring.Node` ids.

props.name: children
props.description: The parts, each wrapped in `Wiring.Node` (and related ones in `Wiring.Group`).

props.name: activeWord
props.description: The word added to an active relation's sentence. Defaults to "on now".

props.name: waitingWord
props.description: The word added to a waiting relation's sentence. Defaults to "waiting".

props.name: title
props.description: The step's printed name. It is also the heading that takes focus when the step opens.

props.name: children
props.description: The step's fields. They stay mounted while the step is closed, so typed values are kept.

props.name: children
props.description: The `WizardStep` elements, in order.

props.name: current
props.description: Zero-based index of the open step, for a controlled Wizard. Pair it with `onCurrentChange`.

props.name: defaultCurrent
props.description: Zero-based index of the step that opens first, for an uncontrolled Wizard. Default 0.

props.name: onCurrentChange
props.description: Called with the new index when Back or Next moves to another step.

props.name: canAdvance
props.description: Asked before Next or Finish leaves the step at `index`. Return false to keep the person here and print the blocked message.

props.name: onBlocked
props.description: Called with the step's index when `canAdvance` returned false.

props.name: onFinish
props.description: Called when Finish is pressed on the last step and `canAdvance` allowed it.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the open step's title, 2 to 6. Default 2.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Word on the Back key. Pass your own for another language.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Word on the Next key.

props.name: finishLabel
props.description: Word on the Finish key, shown on the last step.
